args.content: Correction: The 'reference cohort' definition has changed. It is now the set of customers whose account was created during calendar year 2024, i.e. customers.created_at >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND customers.created_at < DATE '2025-01-01'. This supersedes the prior definition (calendar year 2023). This is a derived business grouping (not a stored column/flag) and should be applied consistently in future analyses that reference the 'reference cohort'.
